notes_ja: 1〜11小節目は休み。11小節目後半のスネアのフィルを合図に12小節目から入ります。A（12〜21小節）は開放Dを付点4分で4回ずつ弾き直し、13・15・17小節目の後半だけC（A弦3フレット）を4分音符3つで弾きます（3拍子に聞こえるヘミオラ）。キックは小節後半を8分の9・11番目で踏みますが、ベースはDの小節では4拍目頭（10番目）なので、つられないように。18小節目から開放Aを1小節半伸ばし、19小節目後半はオクターブ上のA2を4分音符2つ。21小節目はG→E→Gのスライドで22小節目のDへつなぎます。B（22小節〜）は1小節か半小節の長い音が中心で、28・29・31・32小節目は後半の4分音符2つ（B-A、G-F#、B-A、G-E）で次のコードへ。31小節目は頭がB1（A弦2フレット）で後半にB2へ上がる点に注意し、どの音も次の音の直前までレガートで伸ばしてください。
method: Bars 1-11: bass tacet. The bass stem there is ~-80 dBFS RMS vs ~-29 dBFS once the groove starts (≈50 dB lower); its faint D3 sits ~50 dB below the D3 of other.wav and follows that envelope, and the full mix has no low D2/A1 energy beyond what other.wav carries, so the D3 is separation bleed of the drone. The low "D2" thumps basic-pitch found in bars 7-8 and the end of bar 11 are broadband (F#1-A2), coincide with drum hits and the bar-11 fill (drums stem ~15 dB louder in the same frames), i.e. drum bleed, not bass notes. Rhythm: basic-pitch note splits were ignored; re-attacks were taken from dips in the 30-400 Hz RMS envelope and in the 2nd-4th harmonic CQT envelopes (re-plucks show 5-40 dB dips just before the grid point), checked against pYIN f0 and zoomed CQT images. Groove A is legato dotted quarters on D (re-plucked on every beat, bar 16 beat 2 only softly), and in bars 13/15/17 the second half is three quarter-note Cs (eighths 6, 8, 10: a hemiola), not jig eighths; bar 20 is one sustained D. Bars 19/21/28/29/31/32 end with the same two-quarter figure on eighths 8 and 10. Octaves verified from the CQT fundamental (no energy an octave below any written note; A1/B1 fundamentals within 2-5 dB of their 2nd harmonic; A2/B2 in bars 19, 24, 28, 31 have no A1/B1 energy). Tuning ≈ +7 cents (A=440). Attack timing vs grid: median +5 ms, IQR -10..+17 ms. Evaluation (synth vs stem): onset F-measure (50 ms) vs onsets(bass stem, 30-1000 Hz, delta 0.1) per bar: 12:0.75 13:0.75 14:0.86 15:0.50 16:0.33 17:0.89 18:1.00 19:0.86 20:0.67 21:1.00 22:1.00 23:0.00 24:1.00 25:1.00 26:1.00 27:1.00 28:1.00 29:1.00 30:0.57 31:1.00 32:0.86 33:1.00 34:1.00; overall F=0.81 (P=0.77, R=0.86) vs 0.66 for raw basic-pitch; detector-matched (synth through the same detector) F=0.83. Low bars (15, 16, 23, 30) are legato pitch changes with no energy onset plus ~40-60 ms detector lag, not missing notes. Against full-band onsets() F=0.60 because the stem carries hi-hat/drum bleed onsets inside long notes. Bass-band chroma similarity per bar (sustained synth) min 0.955, mean 0.990; worst half-bar 0.897 (bar 19 first half, decaying A1 tail). Uncertain: release points of decaying notes rounded (bar 19 A1 stops ~eighth 7, bar 21 G2 ~7, bar 25 G2 ~10.5); bar 21 E2 is scooped up from ~D2 and slides to G2 without a re-pluck; bar 26 D2 has a quiet slide-in from below. Fingering is a suggestion (open D/A/G strings, B2/A2 on the G string); D-C-A could also be played on the A/E strings with slides. chords = bass note at each change; the eighth-10 notes in bars 21, 28, 29, 31, 32 (and bar 21 eighth 8) are passing/approach tones.
verification: Independent verification (verifier agent). NOTES/RHYTHM/TAB: no changes - every event was re-derived and confirmed. Evidence: (1) pitch per event from zero-padded harmonic-sum spectra: all 62 events match the written pitch (C2 not C#2, F#2 not F2, B not Bb; tuning within ~+-20 c); (2) octave: real A1/B1 notes have the fundamental 0-7 dB below the 2nd harmonic, while the written A2/B2 notes in bars 19, 24, 28, 31 have the lower octave 13-40 dB down (bar 31 eighth 8: B1 drops 14 dB at the re-attack while B2 stays, so the new note is B2); E2 in 27/32 has no E1; (3) re-attacks from 40-800 Hz level dips and harmonic-band (h1-h5) envelopes at every eighth of bars 11-34: every written onset has a dip/attack and no unwritten slot has one; the kick (drums.json: eighths 0,3,6,8,10) causes no dips in sustained bars 20/22/23/26, so the A-section dips at 3/6/9 and the 8/10 hemiola in bars 13/15/17 are real bass articulations; (4) pYIN f0 per sixteenth agrees with the part except transition sixteenths (pre-attack mutes, release glides); (5) releases (level < sustained-15 dB) agree with written ends (bar 21 G2 6.2, bar 25 G2 10.4); bars 18 and 20 have no re-attack; (6) bars 1-11: pYIN finds no voiced pitch; the bar-11 eighth-9 thump is broadband and the ~70 Hz tone there is in drums.wav (fill), so tacet is confirmed; (7) attack timing vs grid median +4 ms (IQR -10..+17 ms); bar 23 G2 enters ~55 ms late and bar 19 A2 ~40 ms early, still best quantized to eighths 0 and 8. Extra observations (not notated, added to notes_ja): bar 15->16 C2->D2 is a slide without a new pluck (pYIN glides 36.1->37.9 across the barline); bar 16 beat-2 re-pluck is a ~5 dB harmonic dip with no fresh attack (kept, medium).
